summary: Export pinned installed Rust components through API and CLI

delivery.outcome: Export pinned installed native Rust components through public API/CLI without donor import or build toolchain; preserve existing export and backend validation, verify actual C ABI, independently merge and clean owned checkout.
nonGoals: No backend/algorithm/ABI/manifest schema/runtime dependency/platform changes, consumer source migration, automatic download, registry release/deploy or performance guarantee.

architecture.decision: Public export_rust_component and export-component CLI select exact installed native-only distribution/version/package/raw manifest pin and Rust library name. Reuse existing lazy stdlib-only backend._rust_component snapshot with ABI1; never import donor/load library at export. Reject dual payload for this atomic export. Extract shared snapshot writer from current export_artifacts; old export preserves canonical JSON behavior, new installed export preserves raw pinned manifest bytes. Validate library name before lookup, convert invalid installed inputs to NativeArtifactError, preserve no-output-on-invalid and no-overwrite contracts. Test fixture/race/ownership/links and real fresh runtime API/CLI with no build packages or compilers; C client reuses output separately.
dataChanges: None; raw existing sorust.rust-component/v1 metadata/payload copied unchanged.
architecture.rollback: Protected reviewed revert; old explicit-path export remains available; preserve all native artifacts/receipts/ignored data.

validation.evidence: Pinned identity/manifest/payload, safe metadata ownership/snapshots, no donor import/load, invalid input/no output, raw metadata bytes, existing export/backend regressions.

Full suites, fresh installed SDK/native wheel API and CLI with no build packages/compilers, independent C ABI client, old-reader acceptance, final artifacts and reused NL8; indexed canonicalv24/pinned Docs.
Local/remote gates, independent frozen-head review/merge, postmerge smoke, current owner release and preserved exact cleanup.
